name: site-visit-trigger-node
author: VoodBuilder
description: Start when a visitor lands on a page, menu link, or path

weaver.summary: Start when a visitor lands on a site page, menu URL, or custom path
notes: Payload includes visitor_key (vpopups_vid), path, page_id, and user_id when logged in.
Chain into Trigger Popup with visitor_key = {{visitor_key}} and Bypass page targeting as needed.
Menu item match uses the resolved URL path — works for non-VoodBuilder pages too.
